justepicdimensions.config.apply_help: Save this section, then reload the selected main configuration or client preferences. Restart-only settings remain pending. Dimension JSON and datapacks are not reloaded.
justepicdimensions.config.failed: Configuration operation failed. Local edits were kept.
justepicdimensions.config.unavailable: This section is unavailable. Refresh to retry.

justepicdimensions.config.applied: Saved and reloaded the selected configuration. Restart and next-selection settings keep their stated timing.
justepicdimensions.config.apply_failed: Saved, but Apply failed: %s. The previous running configuration was retained.
justepicdimensions.config.saved_no_world: Saved. Global settings will be read when opening or creating a world.
justepicdimensions.config.unsaved_help: These edits have not been saved. Discard them to leave, or cancel and use Save or Save & Apply.
justepicdimensions.config.refresh_unsave: Refresh discards unsaved edits in this section and reads its file again. Other sections keep their edits.
justepicdimensions.config.timing.client: Save & Apply updates this client now. Save alone waits for Apply or game restart.
justepicdimensions.config.timing.reload: Applies through Save & Apply when this main file is selected.
justepicdimensions.config.timing.restart: Requires reopening the world or restarting the dedicated server.
justepicdimensions.config.timing.selecti: Used when configuration resources are next selected. Save & Apply does not copy files or reload dimension JSON.
justepicdimensions.config.timing.new_wor: Used for new-world creation. Existing worlds retain their generation settings.
justepicdimensions.config.field.copyDime: Copy dimension JSON when a save has none, or matching manifest identities have a newer global version. This does not select the copied files.
justepicdimensions.config.field.usePerWo: Use the save's dimension JSON when available. Otherwise use global dimension JSON. Copying and selection are separate controls.
justepicdimensions.config.field.copyMain: The global setting copies main TOML into saves when missing or eligible for a version upgrade. This does not select the copied file.
justepicdimensions.config.field.usePerWo: The global setting selects a save's main TOML when available. Changing this in the save's copy does not select that copy. Save & Apply reloads the file now selected by the global switch.
justepicdimensions.config.field.config_i: Pack identity for main TOML upgrades. Existing save files are replaced only when identities match and the global version is newer. Dimension JSON has its own manifest identity.
justepicdimensions.config.field.config_v: Version used when copying main TOML to saves. Increasing this can replace matching older save configurations, retaining backups. Save & Apply does not perform that copy.
justepicdimensions.config.field.enableRe: Allow JED JSON to replace existing vanilla/mod dimension declarations. Disabling this does not prevent new JED dimensions.
justepicdimensions.config.field.enableUn: Honor lifecycle.enabled=false in dimension definitions on restart. Saved terrain is retained. Manual lifecycle commands remain separate.
justepicdimensions.config.field.enableOv: Apply JED provider policies to existing vanilla/mod dimensions. New JED dimensions retain their configured providers when disabled.
Allow JED JSON to change biome sources of existing dimensions after reopening. New JED dimensions keep their configured biomes. Existing terrain is not regenerated.
justepicdimensions.config.field.world_pr: Namespaced native preset used for creating worlds. Empty follows Minecraft's selected preset. Existing saves are unchanged; explicit JED dimension JSON retains precedence.
justepicdimensions.config.field.enableSe: Allow dimensions with a state section to have independent time, weather, gamerules and other world data. Changes require reopening.
Use separate dimension borders instead of native sharing. Changes require reopening the world or restarting the server.
justepicdimensions.config.field.enableCo: Native world commands target the command source's independent dimension. Explicit /jed dimension commands remain available when this is disabled.
justepicdimensions.config.field.initial_: Namespaced destination for genuinely new players. Empty keeps native placement. Existing players are not moved.
justepicdimensions.config.field.enablePl: Enable configured inventory groups for player inventory, equipment, Ender Chest and supported accessory inventories. Saved group data remains managed by the existing player controller.
justepicdimensions.config.field.enableFo: Honor player.force_game_mode policies in dimension definitions. Enabling the switch does not add a mode policy to dimensions that have none.
justepicdimensions.config.field.normalGa: Mode recorded for a new player whose first dimension forces its game mode. Choose survival, creative, adventure or spectator.
justepicdimensions.config.field.tpjAdmin: When enabled, /tpj requires the configured operator level. When disabled, players can use ordinary /tpj travel. Administrative bypass retains its separate permission check.
Required permission level from 0 to 4 when operator-only /tpj is enabled. This does not change the level-2 requirement for editing server configuration.
justepicdimensions.config.field.enableLo: Enable routine operation and timing messages. Required conflict reports, warnings, errors and skipped-item notices remain logged regardless.
justepicdimensions.config.field.enableCo: Display configured grass, foliage and water colors on this client. Disabling restores normal biome colors; nearby terrain refreshes through the existing bounded client queue.
justepicdimensions.config.field.client_l: Maximum positions examined by the client verification scanner each tick. Larger values finish checks sooner but increase client work. The server chooses verification coverage.
Maximum native light checks submitted per client tick, including adjacent emitters. This limits submissions; it does not add extra relighting.
Soft time budget for scanning and submitting native checks. Native light propagation cannot be capped here. The default is 0.5 milliseconds per tick.
Native drain time used for scanner backpressure. Lower values make verification yield sooner when native lighting work is expensive. The default is 2 milliseconds.

justepicdimensions.gui.copy_help: Independent copies keep their own values. Inherit copies follow source edits where this draft has no override. Copy replaces the draft documents; Undo can restore them. Referenced assets remain shared.

justepicdimensions.text.help.generator: Use Terrain setup to choose terrain. Advanced JSON requires a complete generator with its type and required settings; {} is incomplete.
justepicdimensions.text.help.radius: Larger radius increases RAM and CPU processing requirements. Setting to 0 disables spawn retention. spawn_chunks.radius overrides the per-dimension spawnChunkRadius gamerule; omit it to follow the gamerule.

justepicdimensions.builder.help.inventor: Dimensions with the same group share saved inventory, equipment and Ender Chest.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.force_mo: Apply this dimension’s default game mode while the player is here.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.provider: Select world behavior. Built-in providers and registered addons are supported.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.fog_biom: A list of biome IDs used by the provider’s fog policy.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.fog_list: true: fog in listed biomes. false: fog outside listed biomes.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.vaporize: Control whether placed water evaporates as in the Nether.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.surface: Control surface-world behavior used by Minecraft and other mods.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.provider: Enable or disable the provider’s general fog behavior.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.spawn_he: Default spawn-height hint for the provider, in blocks.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.horizon: Vertical horizon position used by rendering, in blocks.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.provider: Provider-specific settings; addon providers define their own schema.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.display_: Name shown in JED dimension lists and travel menus.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.generati: Allow the terrain generator to create structures in new chunks.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.post_del: Minecraft commands run after successful deletion or reset; world shutdown defers them to startup.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.template: Import a saved-world template only when creating a new dimension.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.startup: Open this dimension when the world or server starts.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.keep_loa: Prevent unloading and normally retain spawn chunks; activity is configured separately.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.unload: Leave automatic_unload and idle_seconds unset to inherit global defaults; explicit values override each separately. Temporary dimensions use local settings.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.temporar: Reset temporary terrain after it becomes empty or closes. This is destructive.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.fallback: Destination for lifecycle evacuation when this dimension cannot remain open.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.spawn_ac: native follows Minecraft activity rules; continuous keeps the retained area ticking without players.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.spawn_re: Retain the spawn area; radius 0 disables retention. This is separate from keeping the level open.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.cycle_le: Raw daytime ticks in each day or night; combined length must fit a positive 32-bit integer.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.angle_ra: Sun-angle endpoints are fractions of one turn, from 0 to 1.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.clock_ra: Inclusive repeating time window inside the cycle. Calendar increment counts whole days.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.celestia: native uses Minecraft; cycle uses custom lengths; range restricts the sun angle.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.sleep: Choose native, allow, deny or exploding beds. Bed checkpoint permission is separate.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.bed_chec: Allow beds to record a return point, independently of sleeping permission.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.respawn: Route death respawns; destination_first selects the target before checking its saved bed or anchor.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.snow_ice: native checks biome temperature; disabled prevents formation; ignore_temperature skips temperature checks.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.mobs: Control natural spawning. Peaceful difficulty and doMobSpawning still apply.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.travel: Sky/void travel rules. Positions use [X,Y,Z]; relative positions allow quoted ~ coordinates.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.clock_sp: Negative: native speed. Zero: paused. Positive: day ticks per game tick.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.day_time: Raw clock time: 0 sunrise, 6000 noon, 12000 sunset. Fraction is the partial tick.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.game_tim: Simulation age in ticks; changing this does not regenerate terrain.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.hardcore: true follows the death dimension’s hardcore rule; false follows the server rule.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.light_ch: off disables checks; updates checks block changes; chunks_and_updates also checks received chunks.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.sky: Sky appearance. fixed keeps the authored color; blend 0 keeps biome/day shading, 1 uses authored color.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.clouds: Cloud height and color. fixed ignores day/weather tint; the player’s Clouds option still applies.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.fog: Distance haze color and start/end in blocks. Fluid, effect and boss fog stay native unless overridden.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.body: Sun or moon appearance. Scale 1 is normal; textures use namespaced PNG resource IDs.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.music: Choose native music, silence, a preset or a registered sound. Delay values are ticks.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.renderer: Registered addon renderer and its settings. Missing client code uses the existing fallback and warning.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.weather_: Control weather visuals separately from server weather and precipitation effects.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.end: Independent controls for dragon fight, generated pillars and pillar reconstruction.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.structur: Place an .nbt or .schem spawn structure with transform and [X,Y,Z] integer offset.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.spawn: Select or search the saved spawn point. Height bounds and glass fallback control the search.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.lightnin: Allow natural weather lightning; explicit commands remain separate.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.rain_eff: Allow rain-driven block effects; snow and freezing have separate policies.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.sleep_we: Keep current weather when sleeping advances the clock.
justepicdimensions.builder.timing_initia: Applied when independent world state is first created; reopening restores saved state.
justepicdimensions.builder.timing_load: Reapplied whenever the level is constructed, replacing the saved value.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.native_t: Native dimension type. Changing an existing native definition takes effect after restart.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.generato: Use Terrain setup to choose terrain. Advanced JSON requires a complete generator with its type and required settings; {} is incomplete.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.spawn_ra: Larger radius increases RAM and CPU processing requirements. Setting to 0 disables spawn retention. spawn_chunks.radius overrides the per-dimension spawnChunkRadius gamerule; omit it to follow the gamerule.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.seed: New chunks use this seed on the next safe level load. Existing terrain remains.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.loadouts: Applies after inventory-group restoration. Unavailable accessory slots are skipped and reported to the player.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.brightne: Exactly 16 finite brightness values, for light levels 0 through 15. Does not relight chunks.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.enabled: Enable or disable this dimension at startup. Saved terrain is retained.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.world_st: This dimension’s saved world settings. Initial values apply once; on-load values apply whenever it opens.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.border: Center the border on world spawn. on_load centers when loaded; follow_spawn also follows later spawn changes.
justepicdimensions.builder.type.brightne: Exactly 16 finite brightness values, for light levels 0 through 15. Does not relight chunks.

Create: saves and registers a new dimension without loading it. Available for new dimensions.

Apply: saves and reloads settings for an existing dimension. Changed native terrain may require a restart.

justepicdimensions.builder.help.category: Choose a reusable group for this category. Omit it to keep ordinary shared state. Rules apply on the next dimension arrival or reconnect. Edit group files in Documents.
justepicdimensions.config.field.automati: Use global defaults for idle unloading. Dimension overrides take priority. The Overworld and temporary dimensions are excluded.
Idle delay inherited from the global policy. A dimension can override it with idle_seconds. Changed effective settings restart the countdown on reload.
justepicdimensions.unload.failure: JED failed to unload %1$s during %2$s. Further JED dimension lifecycle changes are blocked. Shut down and restart the server. Saving after this failure cannot be guaranteed.
justepicdimensions.access.evaluation_fai: The access rule could not be evaluated; contact the server owner
justepicdimensions.access.no_fallback: No accessible destination exists for %s. Contact the server owner.
justepicdimensions.access.editor.title: Access Conditions
justepicdimensions.access.editor.replace: Changing the type replaces this condition and its children.
justepicdimensions.access.editor.shared_: Edits affect every dimension using this rule.
justepicdimensions.access.editor.empty_g: Add a condition to this group
justepicdimensions.builder.help.access.r: Reusable condition file required for ordinary entry. Create or edit its nested All / Any / Not conditions here.
Check entry requirements after death. Default: false, allowing respawn without a key dropped on death.
Check entry requirements when reconnecting. Default: false. Denied players go to an accessible fallback.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.access.i: Check requirements for a new player's first spawn. Default: false. Denied players go to an accessible fallback.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.access.n: Allow mobs, vehicles and items to enter. Default: true. These travelers cannot satisfy player conditions.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.access.b: explicit: /tpj bypass may skip requirements. operator: also allow operators automatically. never: enforce requirements even with explicit bypass.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.access.f: Destination for denied respawn or login. Defaults to the lifecycle fallback. Restricted fallbacks are checked before trying the Overworld.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.access.v: locked: show inaccessible dimensions in /tpj list with a lock and reason. hidden: omit them from the player list.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.access.f: requirements: explain failed conditions. generic: show a simple denial. custom: show the configured text component.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.access.m: Native text component used with custom denial feedback, such as a JSON string or an object with text and color.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.mob_poli: Reusable detailed spawning policy. Create a named justepicdimensions/mob_spawning JSON resource in Documents, then select it here. Controls new spawns; existing mobs remain.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.environm: Select a reusable policy for environmental effects, periodic damage, healing and equipment protection.
justepicdimensions.schedule.denied: Entry to %s is closed by its lifecycle schedule.
justepicdimensions.schedule.waiting: Scheduled reset of %s is waiting for the dimension to become empty.
justepicdimensions.schedule.closed: Entry window for %s has closed. Players already inside may stay.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.profiles: Applied in order. Later profiles win; local settings win last. Arrays replace.
justepicdimensions.bundle.title: Dimension bundles
justepicdimensions.bundle.extras: Additional files, as a JSON array
justepicdimensions.bundle.replace_help: Listed conflicts will be replaced and backed up. Active dimensions remain unchanged.
justepicdimensions.pregen.title: Chunk pregeneration
justepicdimensions.pregen.policy_help: Select a reusable Chunky policy. Edit its JSON in Documents. Automation is opt-in.
justepicdimensions.pregen.concurrency_he: Maximum JED-managed jobs generating at once (1-32).
justepicdimensions.pregen.cancel_help: Generated chunks stay. Saved progress for this JED job will be removed.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.pregener: Select a reusable Chunky policy. Edit its JSON in Documents. Automation is opt-in.
justepicdimensions.config.help.pregenera: Maximum JED-managed jobs generating at once (1-32).
justepicdimensions.pregen.denied: Entry to %s is waiting for required pregeneration. Use /jed pregen status %s for progress.
justepicdimensions.pregen.storage_failed: JED pregeneration could not save its progress. Shut down and restart the server after checking storage.
justepicdimensions.config.help.instanceR: Maximum registered instance identities per server session, including retired IDs. Existing worlds are retained when the limit is reached.
justepicdimensions.config.help.instanceL: Maximum instance worlds loaded at once. Instance policies can impose stricter limits.
justepicdimensions.instance.title: Instanced dimensions
justepicdimensions.instance.policy.help: Reusable ownership, permissions, state scopes, seeds and cleanup policy.
justepicdimensions.instance.denied: Instance entry requires current membership and an available run.
justepicdimensions.instance.evacuation_f: You can no longer stay in this instance, and no safe place to move you was available. Reconnect to try again. If this happens again, ask an operator to check the server log.
justepicdimensions.instance.recoverable: Affected world files move to recoverable history; saved player references are relocated.
justepicdimensions.monitor.title: Dimension monitoring
justepicdimensions.config.field.useShowc: Install missing bundled showcase files under config/justepicdimensions/data before world startup. Preserve existing files. Reopen the world/server to register destinations; disabling retains installed files.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.spawn_of: Added to the selected spawn height. Raised spawns need a supporting structure.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.spawn_ar: Clear carried motion or fall distance when travelling to this world spawn. Normal damage resumes immediately.
justepicdimensions.text.showcase.book_fu: Travel to %s stopped: the destination inventory has no room for your tour book. Free a slot there and try again.
justepicdimensions.config.field.globalIn: Keep existing stacks with these full registry IDs through inventory swaps and loadout replacement. Includes carried items, armor and supported accessory/cosmetic slots; excludes Ender Chest. Loadout equipment has priority; conflicts use free carried space. Empty means none. Example: ["example:dimension_key", "example:guide_book"].
justepicdimensions.builder.help.remove_g: Disable global-item retention only when entering this dimension actually swaps inventory groups. Default: false. Has no effect without an inventory swap; never independently deletes items.
justepicdimensions.inventory.retained_fu: Travel to %s stopped: retained items need more inventory space. Free a carried slot in the destination inventory, then try again.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.creature: Overrides the native CREATURE base cap in this dimension. Minecraft's player/chunk scaling remains. Unset inherits the normal cap; 0 stops natural creature spawning. Existing mobs remain.
justepicdimensions.builder.help.structur: Native structure-set IDs to use for new terrain. An empty list disables structure sets; omit the field to use the generator's defaults.
justepicdimensions.text.instance.list_em: No instances are available to you

justepicdimensions.text.command.result_i: (the result will be written to the server log)
justepicdimensions.text.command.started_: JED %s started; the result will be written to the server log
justepicdimensions.text.monitor.header: Dimension monitoring, page %s of %s (%s dimensions). Details: /jed monitor <dimension>
justepicdimensions.text.monitor.row: %s: %s players, %s chunks, tick %s ms (p95 %s ms), disk %s
justepicdimensions.text.monitor.history: History: %s, a sample every %s s, kept for %s
justepicdimensions.text.monitor.tick: Tick time: mean %s ms, p95 %s ms, max %s ms (last %s ticks)
justepicdimensions.text.monitor.disk: Disk: live %s, recoverable history %s, total %s (measured %s ago)
justepicdimensions.text.monitor.disk_req: Disk scan requested; run the command again shortly to see the new sizes
